care.d: An automatic that sits in a drawer stops. Thirty manual winds brings it back to life.
Fresh water, then dry with a soft cloth. Salt eats gaskets faster than anything.
10 ATM means swimming. It doesn't mean unscrewing the crown while the case is wet.
Gaskets harden. Send it back and we'll swap them and retest, parts at cost.

faq.a: The movement and case are genuine Seiko parts. The dial, hands, bezel and crystal are aftermarket, fitted by us. That makes it a custom build, not a factory Seiko — and we never sell it as one.

faq.q: Will it still be water resistant?
faq.a: Yes. Every build is pressure-tested to 10 ATM after assembly. If a test fails, the watch goes back on the bench, not into a box.

faq.q: How long does a custom order take?
faq.a: Usually 7–14 days depending on parts. If something is backordered we tell you before you pay, not after.
Twelve months on the movement and the seals. Accidental damage and normal wear on straps aren't covered.

faq.q: Can you mod a watch I already own?
faq.a: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp with photos and what you want changed, and we'll quote parts and labour separately.

footer_blurb: A small workshop building custom Seiko mods one at a time. No batches, no drop-shipping.

strip.d: Every case goes in the tester twice — after assembly and after the strap swap.
One builder owns a watch from teardown to final regulation.
Movement and seals. We repair, we don't fob you off.
Tracked and insured from the workshop, 2–7 working days.

anatomy.d: Sourced new, ultrasonically cleaned, gaskets replaced before anything goes in.
NH35A automatic, hacking and hand-winding, regulated on a timegrapher to ±10 s/day.
Your pick — sunburst, matte, or hand-painted with C3 or BGW9 lume.
Pressed on with a fitting set, checked for clearance at every position.
Aligned to the dial track. Misalignment is the fastest way to spot a lazy mod.
Double-domed sapphire with blue AR, ceramic or steel insert seated with a press.
Fitted, then back into the pressure tester before it's boxed.
